description: Scan an MCP server's source code for security vulnerabilities: overly broad permissions, missing input validation, data exfiltration, insecure patterns. Returns grade (A-F) and recommendations.

manifest.description: Also scan server.json manifest file for poisoning indicators (tool poisoning, name spoofing, description injection)

server_path.description: Path to MCP server directory or entry file

update_baseline.description: Write current server.json tool hashes as the trusted baseline for future rug pull detection. Stored in .mcp-security-baseline.json in the server directory.

verbosity.description: Response detail level: 'minimal' (counts only), 'compact' (default, actionable info), 'full' (complete metadata)

name: scan_mcp_server
